name: tether
description: Claude Code plugins: tether, project-neutral guards, telemetry and evals configured per project; tether-nx, Angular and Nx rules; tether-web, the workflow agents and process skills that apply them; tether-rn, React Native rules; and tether-mobile, the workflow agents for a React Native app.

plugins.name: tether
plugins.description: Project-neutral hooks and tools that read every project value from the project's .claude/harness.json; a project without that file gets no behaviour.

plugins.name: tether-nx
plugins.description: Angular and Nx rules for Claude Code agents: library layers, route-scoped providers, signals over RxJS, SignalStore and PrimeNG rules, performance and accessibility; the agents that apply them live in tether-web. A project overrides any rule in .claude/tether-nx.md.

plugins.name: tether-web
plugins.description: Workflow agents and process skills for a web front end: investigator, spec-writer, planner, plan-validator, implementers, two reviewers, ui-checker and pr-creator, driven by a per-project .claude/tether-web.md rules file. Depends on tether-nx and the official nx plugin.

plugins.name: tether-rn
plugins.description: React Native rules for Claude Code agents: layers and the import test, one transport identity, native capability wrappers, state placement, navigation params and deep links, build-time config and secrets; the agents that apply them live in tether-mobile. A project overrides any rule in .claude/tether-rn.md.

plugins.name: tether-mobile
plugins.description: Workflow agents and process skills for a React Native app: investigator, spec-writer, planner, plan-validator, implementers, two reviewers and pr-creator, driven by a per-project .claude/tether-mobile.md rules file. Depends on tether-rn.
